attributes.risk_rating_note: Initial assessment: valid RGB and lidar data alone do not establish the required detection performance for camouflaged, partly concealed tigers. Decision: add a separate LWIR channel and evaluate qualified thermal evidence together with RGB and lidar before tiger classification. Runtime measure SOTIF_RT_001 is Done and is reflected in the current system and software architecture. Resulting requirements: TDS_SEN_003 and TDS_SEN_007. Residual-risk acceptance remains open. Validate the benefit, false alarms and warning delay using independent scenarios, including insufficient exposed target area, low thermal contrast (Case C2), range and environmental attenuation. Thermal sensing does not reveal a tiger through opaque cover; sensor diversity alone is not evidence of independence or adequate performance.

Residual-risk acceptance is open. Case C2 assesses the limitations of thermal sensing introduced by runtime measure SOTIF_RT_001 for Case C1. Validate near-background target temperatures across thermal crossover, sun-heated backgrounds and representative operating conditions. Include camouflaged and partially concealed targets to assess the combined C1/C2 scenario. Establish the remaining contrast boundary and the contribution of complementary modalities. Attach scenario results before accepting residual risk. Validate the D-to-C2 contribution only where low thermal contrast coincides with insufficient RGB/lidar compensation. Evaluate Case E separately if the capability monitor also fails to recognize the resulting limitation; do not treat low thermal contrast as automatic loss of overall capability.

Residual-risk acceptance is open. Determine the minimum resolvable target size across the required range and viewing geometry. Validate the resolution boundary and any complementary lidar/infrared support; document where the detection target is not met. Validate the D-to-B contribution only for the small-target subset in which combined sensing remains insufficient; successful complementary sensing is a control scenario, not a missed detection.

Residual-risk acceptance is open. Establish the combined RGB/lidar/LWIR information boundary with all three required channels functioning. Measure detection probability and delay while varying apparent target size, range, exposed target area, rain, illumination, thermal contrast and lidar geometry; record which modalities can compensate. For D-to-B, require the small-target triggering condition and insufficient complementary resolution. For D-to-C2, require low thermal contrast and insufficient RGB/lidar compensation. These edges represent conditional causal contributions within the same scenario, not additional independent hazardous events. They are not links from every instance of Case D to every missed-detection case. For D-to-E, separately evaluate the estimator insufficiency: the propagation graph does not encode an AND gate or claim that sensing insufficiency necessarily causes a monitoring miss. Define the validated operating boundary and unavailable indication against TDS_SAF_006, TDS_SEN_005, TDS_SEN_007 and the linked performance requirements. Runtime measure SOTIF_RT_003 and validation remain open. Do not claim that weighting changes recover absent information, that adding thermal sensing removes all limitations, or that a reduced sensor set meets the current requirements.

Residual-risk acceptance is open. Evaluate pose-dependent classification misses and delay using independent labelled fused inputs. Investigate representation and training-data coverage, confidence thresholds and temporal confirmation; check false-positive tradeoffs after changes. Relate this evidence to integrated system Case A without counting the same scenario twice. Implementation changes and validation remain open.

Residual-risk acceptance is open. Evaluate the fusion weighting and corroboration policy with independent labelled partial-occlusion and clutter scenarios in which useful thermal evidence is present. Compare the available modality evidence with the object hypotheses and aligned samples delivered to TigerDetectionApp. Measure candidate loss, false alarms, detection delay and capability reporting against SWREQ_SEN_004 and SWREQ_SEN_007 and the linked system detection requirements. Runtime measure SOTIF_RT_002 is proposed and remains open; retaining a candidate must not imply confirmed tiger classification or authorize operation outside the required sensor set and validated performance boundary. Verify the contribution to integrated system Case C1, including any compensating detection path, without counting the same hazardous scenario twice. Low-thermal-contrast limitations remain covered by Case C2. Implementation and validation evidence are required before risk acceptance.

Residual-risk acceptance is open. Validate the intended capability estimator and the end-to-end unavailable indication against TDS_ODD_001, TDS_ODD_004 through TDS_ODD_006 and TDS_SAF_006. Use independent scenario ground truth for actual sensing capability, rather than validating the monitor against its own estimates. For D-to-E, show both an actual combined sensing limitation and an estimator that incorrectly accepts the observed evidence; test the control case in which the same limitation is detected and the unavailable indication is issued. Measure sensitivity, false unavailable indications, monitor latency and indication timing. Distinguish genuine unknown evidence from a fresh but unjustifiably optimistic estimate. Document unobservable limits, including unknown-target thermal contrast, and do not assume complete monitoring coverage for pose-dependent classification or fusion-policy errors. Runtime measure SOTIF_RT_003 is open. Low light alone does not establish an operating-condition violation, and a correct unavailable indication does not restore tiger-detection performance. Retain the threshold-justification review until independent evidence supports the thresholds and residual limitations. Do not infer probabilistic independence between the sensing and monitoring paths.

Residual-risk acceptance is open. Validate unusual poses across viewpoints, motion, and partial visibility using independent scenario data. Compare missed detections with the linked performance requirements and record limitations and mitigations.
